Dʰǵʰom, mē kʷékʷlos kʷekʷlóm h₁éstī. Kʷékʷlom h₁es-ti?
English: Dear one, my wheel broke. Do you have a wheel?

Snusó, h₂nḗr dʰwóri stéh₂ti. Mē h₁eis-ēs! H₂ówim pékʷe!
English: Daughter-in-law, a man is standing at the door. Do not leave him. Cook a sheep!

Ph₂tḗr dómi h₁ésti.
English: Father is at home.

H₁éh₁, h₂ésm̥ dʰéh₁kom.
English: Yes, I made the spear.

Ǵʰostis dʰwóri stéh₂ti.
English: A stranger is standing at the door.

Néh₁, h₂ówis ne h₃éydh₂om.
English: No, I have not seen the sheep.

Héh₂, h₁ógʷnis dʰégʷʰeti.
English: Yes, the fire is burning.

H₁ékʷom wesnéh₂mi.
English: I am buying the horse too, then.

Tód h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ h₂nér-os h₁esti.
English: This is the man's wool.

Mé domi h₁édh₁, h₁ékʷ tr̥dʰ pehₓ-!
English: Eat in my house, and drink there!

Pékus h₂egrōd h₁ésti.
English: The flock is in the field.

Ói̯mos h₁es h₃rēǵs dómom h₁éymi.
English: This road goes to the king's house.

Sūnu, h₂erh₃trom ǵʰéd! Dwó gʷṓw h₂erh₃tro yéwgs!
English: Son, hold the plough! Join the two cattle to the plough.

Dʰugh₂tér, sh₂uel h₁eit h₂ékʷ-ōm dʰéh₁mi.
English: Daughter, the sun goes along its path.

To Father Sky (Dyeus), for Father Sky.
Dawn, daughter of the Sky, shines.
The sons of the Sky stand by the horses.
The Sun's daughter stood on the chariot.
You do not put them to sleep.
With two good horses, the swift one.
The serpent is slain; he lies there.
Who slay him, they do not slay.
I slay the serpent with a club.
He, the maker, made imperishable fame.
He gave a name to the son.
Let his name be this for him.
Those of good fame (men of good renown).
Let the blood flow out of you (be released) by the vein.
I fashion a word for him.
We would like to cause the giver of good things to be gratified (we make the giver of goods flourish).
May there be good fame for him.
I pray to the Sky-god's great father (for the great father of the sky god).
You make the earth and the sky tremble/shake.
The wide earth bears us a good (wide) gift.
The daughter of the Sky-god was born.
